bad_cards.problem: Misleading out of context: the source immediately qualifies Herodotus' revenge motive ('są jednak powody, by tezę tę uznać za element ateńskiej propagandy'). Card presents it without that caveat; a grader could reward an unhedged claim.
bad_cards.fix: Extend the quote to include the propaganda caveat, or add it to the fact sentence.

bk117-eval-02.notes: Ustrój (consuls, assemblies, tribunes, senate) and social aspect (patrician–plebeian struggle, XII Tables, debt bondage, lex Hortensia, latifundia) covered; effectiveness via 700k reserves and senate foreign policy. ev-02-f08 fact adds 'W okresie wielkich podbojów' (context is 2nd-c. BC treaty practice) – acceptable.

bk117-eval-03.notes: Religious and political causes (source headers 'Przyczyny polityczne/religijne' confirm labels in ev-03-f04/f05), effects incl. economic (Levant trade, Italian cities, shipping) and political (Byzantium weakened, French kings). Quotes of this item match the source only after whitespace normalisation (bullet-list items joined); content is verbatim.

bad_cards.problem: Fact adds 'co osłabiało odporność ludności', which is not in the quote (it is in the next source sentence via livestock shortage → malnutrition).
bad_cards.fix: Extend quote with 'Deficyty pszenicy, owsa i jęczmienia ... niedożywienie, obniżające odporność.' or drop the clause from the fact.

bk117-eval-04.notes: Causes/course and demographic (30–60%, world population) plus social (structure, Church) covered, but ECONOMIC effects are thin: only the drop in German settlements (ev-04-f10); nothing on labour shortage, wages or prices after the plague. ev-04-f04 is a pre-plague cause, not an effect. Add 1–2 economic-effect cards from the source if available.

bad_cards.problem: Fact adds 'i Płowcami'; quote covers only the morning encounter near Radziejów. The battle of Płowce is supported by the next source paragraph, not by this quote.
bad_cards.fix: Quote the Płowce sentence ('Po południu doszło do kolejnego starcia pod wsią Płowce...') or drop 'i Płowcami'.
